description: Finds the last tickets that would finish an initiative, and which of them are free to pick up. An initiative is a parent ticket that groups the tickets of one larger piece of work. For a repository it lists the initiatives the dashboard classes as almost done (a few tickets left that belong to the original push; by default 3 or fewer open and at least 75% closed, a setting the team can change), smallest remainder first. Each comes with its remaining tickets (number, title, link, phase, whether someone is working on it, who has claimed it) and the dashboard's reason in plain words. Use it when your human asks what is close to finished, or when you are choosing what to work on: closing one of these tickets finishes something. unclaimed_only lists only tickets nobody is working on or has claimed. include_next_part also lists initiatives whose first part is done but whose remaining tickets were filed later and not started (better moved into a new initiative than counted as nearly done). Read-only, and it never fails: if the list cannot be read it says why. Before starting a ticket, check it with board and claim it as usual.

include_next_part.description: Also list initiatives whose first part is done and whose next part has not started.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.

unclaimed_only.description: Only tickets that are free to pick up: not in progress and claimed by nobody. Initiatives with none are left out (and counted).

name: almost_done
title: Initiatives a few tickets from finished
